The interactive preview runs this whole script in AutoJs6, exactly like the Run command, with every side effect it has (files, network, device actions). Its ui.layout fills the canvas; the document and the file stay unchanged. The script stops when the switch goes off or the designer is left.

The interactive preview runs this whole script in AutoJs6, exactly like the Run command, with every side effect it has (files, network, device actions). Its ui.layout fills the canvas; the document and the file stay unchanged. The script stops when the switch goes off or the editor closes; while the designer is in the background the script gets pause, and resume when it comes back, like an app.
